CAN_GO skips closed doors, so the cry behind 8040s shut west gate is muffled while the open north side hears it. The listener beyond the gate is the primary; the killer peer drives the mob death via a directed send step.

A miss still calls damage(ch,victim,0,attacktype), so after the miss message C runs update_pos, the position bytes, the !AWAKE stop_fighting and the default arm's bleed check with the victim's MOB_WIMPY flee; the port returned early, dropping do_flee's six direction draws and drifting the shared stream (R1/R3/R5e).
A forced miss against a below-quarter-HP MOB_WIMPY victim reaches the flee callback; the revert keeps the old early return and the test fails (R1/R5h).

ANSI color audit: at C_CMP C brackets the attacker TO_CHAR line with CCYEL/CCNRM and the victim TO_VICT|TO_SLEEP line with CCRED/CCNRM, while the room act() carries none. The pre-audit port emitted both private lines uncolored, so every damaging weapon hit was plain; keep-ansi proves the raw escapes. R1/R5e/R5h.

ANSI color audit: the wounded-band line is one sprintf carrying CCRED(victim, C_SPR)/CCNRM with the reset before the CRLF, gated at C_SPR so a single color bit still shows it. The pre-audit port emitted the bare literal at three call sites; the poison tick keeps the victim standing so the default arm is taken. R1/R5e/R5h.

do_headbutt passes SKILL_HEADBUTT (141) to damage(); make_corpse's switch turns that value into the corpse's long description. The port re-derived the type from a skill name and fell to TYPE_SLASH (303), so bash, kick, headbutt, trip, bearhug and strike printed the wrong corpse wording while their skill_message text matched. The scenario kills the trainee guard and looks; the unit tests drive the same pipeline and fail on revert. R1/R5e/R5h.
